en: A black-and-white aerial photograph of a European town, featuring a prominent graduation tower structure (a long wooden framework used in salt production), rows of traditional houses with pitched roofs, several tall smokestacks indicating light industry, and fields and hills in the background. The town is surrounded by a rural landscape, with a forested hill and some visible churches or towers in the distance.
